audience.programmeDescription: Study how the human brain supports cognition and behaviour, combining biological and psychological knowledge with mathematics, programming, data analysis and neurotechnology. Research projects develop experimental and academic skills.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR has relevant study in cognition, biology, mathematics and data methods. The published Radboud requirements do not yet establish a complete curriculum for a reliable degree comparison, so only the supported external allocation is shown and UCR alternatives are withheld.

curriculum.routeLabel: Supported allocation; later years still in development
curriculum.limitation: The degree is 180 EC. The published allocation accounts for 164 EC, including 60 EC of provisional second-year learning lines. The remaining 16 EC and the final later-year course structure are not established. This is a partial allocation, not a complete degree pathway.

componentNotes.y1-linear-algebra: Required first-year course: 3 EC in the adopted regulations and current programme overview.
componentNotes.y2-foundations: 24 EC provisionally allocated to this second-year learning line. Its final course structure is still in development.
componentNotes.y2-stem: 18 EC provisionally allocated to this second-year learning line. Its final course structure is still in development.
componentNotes.y2-integration: 12 EC provisionally allocated to this second-year learning line. Its final course structure is still in development.
componentNotes.y2-academic-skills: 5 EC provisionally allocated to this second-year learning line. Its final course structure is still in development.
componentNotes.y2-development: 1 EC provisionally allocated to this second-year learning line. Its final course structure is still in development.
componentNotes.y3-research-project: Required 18-EC scientific internship and final research report: formulate hypotheses, conduct an experiment, analyse results and communicate findings.
componentNotes.y3-free-space: 26 EC of free choices, within neuroscience, technology or STEM, or from other university subjects. The complete third-year structure is still unpublished.
componentNotes.y1-neuroquest1: Research Design and Scientific Method knowledge is assumed; taking the writing workshop alongside Neuroquest 1 is strongly advised.
componentNotes.y1-neuroquest2: Neuroquest 1 knowledge is assumed; taking Data Science 1 alongside this project is strongly advised.
componentNotes.y1-neurons: Knowledge from Foundations of Cognitive Neuroscience and Biological Origins of Cognition is assumed.
